resources.string: Choose conversations inside Instagram → InstaEclipse → Lock → Choose chats to lock. Turn off Lock Messages to keep the inbox unlocked and protect only your chosen chats.

Lock Messages stays unlocked while you browse messages and conversations. With Lock again when you leave on, it locks again after you leave Messages. Chosen chats lock again after you leave that conversation.
Open your Direct inbox first to load available chats, then return here.
Enter passcode to change chat locks
Enter passcode to view hidden chats
Set a passcode in InstaEclipse Lock settings first.
Enter passcode to open this chat
Hidden chats are unavailable for this inbox.
